items.title: File Einspruch against the 2025 income tax assessment
items.quote: Der Einspruch muss binnen eines Monats nach der Bekanntgabe beim Finanzamt Musterhöhe eingehen, schriftlich, über das Portal ELSTER oder mündlich zur Niederschrift.
items.computation: Letter dated Thu 19.11.2026; no separate 'zur Post gegeben' date is stated, so the printed date is the posting day. Posted on/after 1 Jan 2025 → delivery fiction = 4th calendar day after posting: 20.11 (1), 21.11 (2), 22.11 (3), 23.11 (4) = Mon 23.11.2026. This is a Finanzamt (§108 Abs.3 AO applies), so if the 4th day were a weekend/holiday it would move to the next working day; 23.11.2026 is a Monday and not a holiday in Hesse (the Finanzamt's seat, postal code 35578 = Wetzlar/Hesse), so delivery stands on 23.11.2026. One-month Einspruch period (§355 Abs.1 AO, counted per §108 Abs.1 AO / §§187,188 BGB) runs from the delivery day to the same day-number in the following month: 23.12.2026. 23.12.2026 is a Wednesday and not a public holiday in Hesse or nationwide, so no weekend/holiday extension (§108 Abs.3 AO) is needed.
